name: What is the process for repairing dry rot?
description: The repair process involves eliminating moisture, removing infected wood, fungicidal treatment, and replacing timber. Extensive rot can increase complexity.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for repairing dry rot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dry rot repair typically involves identifying and eliminating the moisture source, removing all infected wood, and treating surrounding areas with a fungicide to prevent recurrence. Sound timber is then replaced with new, pre-treated wood. The process clarity can be affected by the extent of the dry rot; more widespread infestations might require opening up walls or floors to access all affected structural elements, which adds to the project's complexity and duration.
